question: The least number of all-equal calls per dead depth in living states of the usual limit, against the proved copy bounds; simultaneity; nesting.

definitions.w: least witnesses at depth t, SAT + incremental totalizer
definitions.A, B: disjoint dead copies; each weighted by its own least count (one-definition families)

public_inputs.code: census.py (sha256 49f5c6359189a8f9d2278c842d12acf8aa42fe2e264ecc734feef3a18e4e8675) beside this file; LIMIT-STATE census.py; SHORT-DESC dlang.py; pysat; numpy.
public_inputs.run: census.py --run W 16 for W in 0-15, then --summary, from the repository root; output artifacts/WITNESS-COUNT-20261112-001A/WITNESS-COUNT-20261112-001A-E001_witness_count/.

forbidden_inputs: Changing families, bounds, queries, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
primary_observable: Share of one-definition families with w = B at T+1 and T+2; share with a jointly least state.
cheapest_meaningful_control: The proved bounds A and B (a state below them is a gate failure).

predictions.P1: w = B at T+1, T+2 in >= 90% of one-definition families
predictions.P2: joint least state in >= 90% of families read

stop_rule: One run and its summary; a hand-off to the referee thread; report.
